title: Book Two · Chapter 6: One Turn Each
story:
Dad comes home a little before four on Saturday.

Ronan is waiting by the blue bike. He is not sitting on it. Mrs Lan needs the path to bring in her shopping.

“Did you eat?” Mum asks Dad.

“Yes. Mr Sun and I had a late lunch.”

He washes his hands. Ronan carries the clean cloth to him, then puts it back in the kitchen box.

The ground is dry. They walk the bike to the open space.

Leo and his mother are waiting by the wall. Leo has changed his shoes. Ronan looks at them.

“No windows today.”

“Not yet,” Leo says.

Dad checks the blue bike. Ronan gets on and rides to the far mark. He turns slowly and comes back.

This time Dad does not walk beside him. He stands near the turning place.

Ronan stops with both feet on the ground.

“Again?”

“Give Leo a turn first.”

Ronan moves away from the seat. Leo's mother holds the back while Leo tries the height. His feet reach the ground.

“Slowly,” she says.

Leo rides round once. At the turn he almost puts a foot down. Then he comes back and stops.

“The bell is loud,” he says.

“You did not ring it.”

“I remember.”

They take turns. Dad puts two little sticks by the wall to mark the waiting place. The boys stand there with both feet clear of the path.

Leo wants to go faster. His mother says no. Dad asks Ronan to show one slow stop instead.

Ronan rides a short way and stops before the second stick.

Leo tries next. He stops too far away. He brings the bike back and tries again.

This time the front wheel stops beside the stick.

“Now you can give the wall a rest,” Ronan says.

Leo looks up. “Did your old wall get better?”

“It still has the mark.”

Both boys laugh.

They leave the space before it grows dark. Leo and his mother turn towards home. Dad walks the blue bike along the busy road. Ronan stays beside him.

At the green gate, Mr Qiu looks up from his little table.

“Good ride?”

“Leo stopped at the mark,” Ronan says.

“And you?”

“I did too.”

“That sounds like enough for one afternoon.”

Inside, Ronan puts his book on the table. Dad is cleaning a little dust from a wheel.

“Do you remember the English word?” Ronan asks.

Dad leaves the cloth for a moment. He looks at the page.

“Bridge.”

Ronan smiles.

“Now the next word?” Dad asks.

“I cannot read that one yet.”

They look at the small letters together. Neither says anything for a while.

Then Mum comes in with a bowl.

“Books off the table, please. The food needs a turn too.”

Ronan closes the book. Dad puts the bike by the wall.

At dinner, they tell Mum about the sticks and the slow stops. She asks, “Did Leo bring his shoes home too?”

“All of them,” Ronan says.

“Good. No spare feet in the yard tonight.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

turn＝轮流的一次；mark＝标记；height＝高度；reach＝够到。

## 理解问题

1. 两个孩子怎样轮流练车？
2. Dad会读一个英文词后，是否已经会读下一词？

## 读句子

His feet / reach / the ground.＝他的脚／够到／地面。
